summary_of_core_decisions: The text presents a nuanced, qualified defense of physicalism against the inverted spectrum argument. It argues that the thought experiment reveals an epistemic gap between functional knowledge and phenomenal knowledge, but does not establish a metaphysical gap. The central move is distinguishing epistemological limitations from ontological conclusions, while acknowledging that the explanatory gap persists even if physicalism is true.

thesis_commitment.conclusion_type: Qualified - the text defends a carefully circumscribed position rather than an unqualified claim
thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: High - the conclusion emphasizes what the argument does NOT show as much as what it does show
